training: 360 official annotated train ROIs from virat-ground-000201 and virat-ground-000206 only
evaluations: 57 user-confirmed moving-target observations on local2415171, GT analysis ROI B
14 matched candidate ROIs C on the same local2415171 observations
feature_contract: existing 32x32 uint8 grayscale OpenCV HOG324; unchanged descriptor and inference preprocessing
translation: integer nearest-neighbor in already normalized 32x32 ROI with BORDER_REPLICATE; not expansion into unseen source pixels
augmentation_weight: each original training ROI has total sample_weight 1, including its unchanged copy
scaler: fit on each training variant only; fold into weights/bias at inference
threshold: score >= 0 vehicle else ped; no tuning or rejection threshold search
pilot_gate: At each official val scene, local GT and local matched-candidate evaluation: vehicle correct counts and ped correct counts must not decrease vs frozen baseline; ped correct count must increase in at least one evaluation. Quantized models must also meet the existing <=1% mismatch and <=1 percentage-point per-class recall-loss conditions and the margin error condition.
stop: report all three fits once; no further sweep. Passing is only a diagnostic route decision, not model acceptance or deployment permission.
